research_question: Does v1 C1 contain genuinely new foreign information accumulated while China is closed, or is its holdout improvement mostly a Ridge duplicate-feature regularization artifact?

mechanism_features.cum_nasdaq: NASDAQ level at last US close strictly before target China day / NASDAQ level at last US close strictly before previous China day - 1
mechanism_features.cum_vix: VIX level at last US close strictly before target China day / VIX level at last US close strictly before previous China day - 1
mechanism_features.extra_nasdaq: cum_nasdaq - existing panel us_nasdaq; isolates information beyond the final US session already present in baseline
mechanism_features.extra_vix: cum_vix - existing panel us_vix_chg; isolates information beyond the final US session already present in baseline
mechanism_features.us_session_intervals: end_US_index - start_US_index; normal one-session transmission is 1; multi-session unabsorbed windows are >=2
mechanism_features.duplicate_placebo: exact copies of existing us_nasdaq and us_vix_chg; contains zero new information and diagnoses Ridge duplicate-feature shrinkage effects

candidate_family.features: baseline + extra_nasdaq*(holiday_reopen==0 and us_session_intervals>=2) + extra_vix*(holiday_reopen==0 and us_session_intervals>=2)

frozen_subsets.ordinary_gap: abs(gap) <= 0.003 using the already-frozen 30bp overnight-ledger cut
frozen_subsets.tail_gap: abs(gap) > 0.003 using the already-frozen 30bp overnight-ledger cut

diagnostic_decomposition.influence: report top_1/top_5/top_10 positive SSE-improvement share; do not delete observations or retune after inspection

decision_rules.new_information_mechanism_supported: C3 holdout IC must exceed C0 by more than numerical replay tolerance; otherwise reject genuine cumulative-information interpretation regardless of C1
decision_rules.duplicate_regularization_artifact_presen: C2 holdout IC above C0 establishes that duplicate-feature Ridge geometry can create apparent improvement; quantify but do not use a post-result threshold to erase a positive C3
decision_rules.source_attribution: C4 and C5 are diagnostics only; they cannot be promoted separately in this round
decision_rules.closure_localization: C6/C7 and additive SSE decomposition identify where the C3 gain occurs; no subset-specific runtime routing may be promoted from this consumed holdout
decision_rules.baseline_replacement: forbidden in this round regardless of result because 2019-2020 is already consumed internal holdout
